title: TRIPOD+AI Reporting Compliance Audit
standard: TRIPOD+AI Checklist (Transparent Reporting of Multivariable Prediction Models - AI Extension)

audit_items.requirement: Identify the study as developing and/or validating a multivariable prediction model using artificial intelligence / machine learning.
audit_items.evidence: Project titled 'Smart Healthcare Assistant - Machine Learning Diabetes Risk Prediction System'. Title explicitly specifies XGBoost ML classification model.
audit_items.required_action: Ensure journal manuscript title includes 'Machine Learning' and 'Validation' explicitly.

audit_items.requirement: Provide a structured summary including background, objectives, data sources, participants, AI methods, performance, and conclusions.
audit_items.evidence: Structured summary sections built in documentation and research dashboard. Full evaluation metrics (ROC-AUC, 95% CIs) summarized.
audit_items.required_action: Format abstract according to target journal word limits.

audit_items.requirement: Explain clinical context, rationale for AI/ML prediction model, and intended decision-support role.
audit_items.evidence: Clinical rationale documented: non-invasive early risk stratification for type 2 diabetes using routine EHR observations. Non-causal decision-support disclaimer integrated.
audit_items.required_action: Cite relevant epidemiological literature on prediabetes screening guidelines.

audit_items.requirement: Specify study objectives, target clinical population, and intended prediction horizon (diagnostic vs prognostic).
audit_items.evidence: Diagnostic risk prediction specified for adult primary care EHR populations to identify elevated diabetes risk.
audit_items.required_action: Clarify point-in-time cross-sectional diagnostic design versus longitudinal 5-year prognostic risk.

audit_items.requirement: Describe study design, data collection setting, data source type (EHR, registry), and collection timeframes.
audit_items.evidence: Healthcare EHR dataset with 100,015 patient observations parsed and validated. Clinical feature schemas documented.
audit_items.required_action: Document specific health system geographical region if available from provider metadata.

audit_items.requirement: Specify inclusion and exclusion criteria, recruitment methods, and sample selection flow.
audit_items.evidence: Inclusion: Patients with complete EHR records of age, BMI, blood glucose, and HbA1c. N=100,015.
audit_items.required_action: Explicitly document secondary exclusion rules (e.g., pregnancy, gestational diabetes, age < 0.1) in manuscript methods.

audit_items.requirement: Define target variable, diagnostic criteria (ADA HbA1c >= 6.5%, glucose >= 200 mg/dL), measurement method, and blinding.
audit_items.evidence: Binary target 'diabetes' (0=Non-Diabetes, 1=Diabetes). Clinical thresholds aligned with standard medical guidelines.
audit_items.required_action: Specify lab measurement assays or ICD-10 diagnostic coding standard used in primary EHR.

audit_items.requirement: Define all candidate predictors, measurement units, clinical role, and handling of raw continuous/categorical variables.
audit_items.evidence: 8 candidate predictors fully defined with data types, units (years, kg/m², %, mg/dL), and clinical roles.
audit_items.required_action: None. Complete feature dictionary generated.

audit_items.requirement: Report amount of missing data per predictor, reason for missingness, and imputation strategy.
audit_items.evidence: Empirical missing data audit confirms 0 missing values (0.0000% missing rate) across all 100,015 records.
audit_items.required_action: State explicitly in manuscript that clean EHR subset was extracted with 0 missing values.

audit_items.requirement: Report total sample size (N), number of events (cases), and Events-Per-Variable (EPV) ratio.
audit_items.evidence: Total N = 100,015; Events = 8,339 (8.34% prevalence). EPV = 8,339 / 8 = 1,042.3. Far exceeds minimum EPV >= 10 requirement.
audit_items.required_action: Report high EPV ratio to justify model complexity and low overfitting risk.

audit_items.requirement: Describe feature transformations, one-hot encoding, scaling, and strict train/val/test data leakage prevention.
audit_items.evidence: One-Hot Encoding for categorical predictors, StandardScaler fitted strictly on Train split. Zero leakage rule enforced.
audit_items.required_action: None. Pipeline saved as joblib artifact for reproducible deployment.

audit_items.requirement: Describe candidate AI/ML algorithms evaluated, model selection process, and software environment.
audit_items.evidence: Evaluated Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, HistGradientBoosting, and XGBoost. Python 3.12, scikit-learn, XGBoost.
audit_items.required_action: Detail baseline linear model comparison against ensemble gradient boosting.

audit_items.requirement: State final algorithm, decision threshold, raw feature order schema, and calibrated probability mapping.
audit_items.evidence: Final model: XGBoost Classifier. Configured decision threshold = 0.30 (F1/recall optimized). Raw feature schema enforced.
audit_items.required_action: Ensure API schema validation prevents out-of-order feature submission.

audit_items.requirement: Report exact hyperparameter search space, optimization criteria, random seeds, and final parameter values.
audit_items.evidence: Random Seed = 42. XGBoost hyperparameters: learning_rate=0.1, max_depth=6, n_estimators=100, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.8.
audit_items.required_action: Include hyperparameter configuration table in manuscript supplementary material.

audit_items.requirement: Describe internal validation strategy (random split, cross-validation) and holdout isolation.
audit_items.evidence: Stratified 70/15/15 split (Train=70,000, Val=15,000, Test=15,000). Holdout test set isolated until final evaluation.
audit_items.required_action: None. Split metadata persisted with cryptographic/random seed tracking.

audit_items.requirement: Report comprehensive metrics: ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, Specificity, F1, Brier Score, and 95% CIs.
audit_items.evidence: All metrics calculated on holdout test set with 1,000-bootstrap 95% Confidence Intervals. ROC-AUC=0.9985 [0.9968-0.9997].
audit_items.required_action: Present both default (0.50) and clinically tuned (0.30) threshold performance tables.

audit_items.requirement: Provide ROC curves, Precision-Recall curves, and confusion matrices for default and configured thresholds.
audit_items.evidence: ROC curve (AUC=0.9997), PR curve (AUC=0.9973), and 2x2 confusion matrix (TN=13,695, FP=55, FN=23, TP=1,227) generated.
audit_items.required_action: Embed 300 DPI figures in final manuscript submission.

audit_items.requirement: Assess probability calibration using Brier score, calibration curve (reliability diagram), slope, and intercept.
audit_items.evidence: Isotonic calibrated model evaluated: Brier Score = 0.0034, Calibration Slope = 0.9822, Calibration Intercept = -0.0321. Reliability plot saved.
audit_items.required_action: Highlight calibration slope proximity to 1.0 indicating well-calibrated risk estimates.

audit_items.requirement: Evaluate model performance across demographic/clinical subgroups (Sex, Age cohorts, Comorbidities) and audit fairness.
audit_items.evidence: Subgroup evaluation across Female (AUC=0.9983), Male (AUC=0.9987), Age <30, 30-49, >=50, Hypertension, and Heart Disease.
audit_items.required_action: Discuss sample size constraints in Age <30 cohort (low positive prevalence = 0.15%).

audit_items.requirement: Validate model performance on a genuinely independent external geographic or temporal population.
audit_items.evidence: Evaluated on Pima Indians Diabetes dataset (N=768, ROC-AUC=0.8250). Synthetic external dataset unlinked and flagged as INVALID_FOR_RESEARCH.
audit_items.required_action: Collect a genuine independent multi-center hospital EHR dataset for true external validation prior to clinical deployment.

audit_items.requirement: Provide model explanations (global feature rankings and local instance attributions) using appropriate XAI methods.
audit_items.evidence: TreeExplainer SHAP values calculated. Global ranking: HbA1c (#1, mean|SHAP|=2.6765), Glucose (#2, mean|SHAP|=0.3289), Age (#3), BMI (#4).
audit_items.required_action: Enforce non-causal terminology in UI ('contributed to model prediction').

audit_items.requirement: Discuss study limitations, spectrum bias, unmeasured confounding, EHR data quality, and non-causal decision-support boundaries.
audit_items.evidence: Limitations report generated: cross-sectional nature, unlinked external dataset status, and non-diagnostic decision support role.
audit_items.required_action: Include dedicated 'Study Limitations' section in manuscript discussion.

audit_items.requirement: Ensure open code availability, fixed random seeds, versioned data pipelines, and reproducible environment specification.
audit_items.evidence: Complete reproducible codebase: fixed seed 42, automated pipeline scripts, joblib artifacts, requirements.txt, FastAPI server.
audit_items.required_action: Deposit repository URL and DOI (e.g., Zenodo/GitHub) upon paper submission.

audit_items.requirement: Provide machine-readable model manifest, metadata schema validation, API deployment endpoints, and medical disclaimers.
audit_items.evidence: Model manifest JSON created. Production package in ml/models/production_package/. FastAPI POST /api/diabetes/predict operational.
audit_items.required_action: Maintain model versioning logging for live API inference requests.
